FlyCorner.Parent = FlyBtn

    if state then
        FlyBtn.Text = "STOP"
        FlyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 80)
    else
        FlyBtn.Text = "FLY"
        FlyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 90, 220)
    end
end

-- ===== Логика полёта =====
local function getRoot()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    return char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
end

local function stopFly()
    Flying = false
    setFlyVisual(false)
    if Conn then Conn:Disconnect() Conn = nil end
    if BodyVel then BodyVel:Destroy() BodyVel = nil end
    if BodyGyro then BodyGyro:Destroy() BodyGyro = nil end
    local hum = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then
        hum.PlatformStand = false
    end
end

local function startFly()
    local root = getRoot()
    local hum = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not root or not hum then return end

    Flying = true
    setFlyVisual(true)

    BodyVel = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    BodyVel.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
    BodyVel.Velocity = Vector3.zero
    BodyVel.Parent = root

    BodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    BodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
    BodyGyro.P = 9e4
    BodyGyro.Parent = root

    hum.PlatformStand = true

    Conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not Flying or not root or not root.Parent then
            stopFly()
            return
        end

        local camCF = Camera.CFrame
        local move = Vector3.zero

        if Keys.W then move = move + camCF.LookVector end
        if Keys.S then move = move - camCF.LookVector end
        if Keys.A then move = move - camCF.RightVector end
        if Keys.D then move = move + camCF.RightVector end

        -- вертикаль от кнопок + клавиш
        local up = Vertical
        if Keys.Space then up = up + 1 end
        if Keys.Ctrl  then up = up - 1 end

        if move.Magnitude > 0 then
            move = move.Unit * Speed
        end
        move = move + Vector3.new(0, up * Speed, 0)

        BodyVel.Velocity = move
        BodyGyro.CFrame = camCF
    end)
end

local function toggleFly()
    if Flying then
        stopFly()
    else
        startFly()
    end
end

FlyBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleFly)

-- Клавиши
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
    if gp then return end
    local key = input.KeyCode
    if key == Enum.KeyCode.W then Keys.W = true end
    if key == Enum.KeyCode.A then Keys.A = true end
    if key == Enum.KeyCode.S then Keys.S = true end
    if key == Enum.KeyCode.D then Keys.D = true end
    if key == Enum.KeyCode.Space then Keys.Space = true end
    if key == Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl or key == Enum.KeyCode.RightControl then Keys.Ctrl = true end
    if key == Enum.KeyCode.F then toggleFly() end   -- быстрый тогл на F
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    local key = input.KeyCode
    if key == Enum.KeyCode.W then Keys.W = false end
    if key == Enum.KeyCode.A then Keys.A = false end
    if key == Enum.KeyCode.S then Keys.S = false end
    if key == Enum.KeyCode.D then Keys.D = false end
    if key == Enum.KeyCode.Space then Keys.Space = false end
    if key == Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl or key == Enum.KeyCode.RightControl then Keys.Ctrl = false end
end)

-- При респавне выключаем
LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    if Flying then stopFly() end
end)

print("[Minimal Fly] loaded • F = toggle")

	local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

				if visible and screen.Z > 0 then
					local distance = (Vector2.new(screen.X, screen.Y) - Vector2.new(mouse.X, mouse.Y)).Magnitude
					if distance < closestDistance then
						closestDistance = distance

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local CONFIG_FILE_NAME = "TraitDebuggerConfig.json"

local function saveSettings(data)
	local jsonString = HttpService:JSONEncode(data)
	
	if writefile then
		pcall(function() writefile(CONFIG_FILE_NAME, jsonString) end)
	end
	
	pcall(function()
		TeleportService:SetTeleportSetting("TraitDebuggerConfig", jsonString)
	end)
end

local function loadSettings()
	local rawData = nil
	
	if readfile and isfile and isfile(CONFIG_FILE_NAME) then
		pcall(function() rawData = readfile(CONFIG_FILE_NAME) end)
	end
	
	if not rawData then
		pcall(function() rawData = TeleportService:GetTeleportSetting("TraitDebuggerConfig") end)
	end
	
	if rawData then
		local success, decoded = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(rawData) end)
		if success and type(decoded) == "table" then
			return decoded
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local workbenchEspEnabled = true
local WORKBENCH_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 150)
local WORKBENCH_HL_NAME = "WorkbenchESP"
local leaderboardVisible = true

local function setLeaderboardState(state)
	leaderboardVisible = state
	pcall(function()
		StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.PlayerList, leaderboardVisible)
	end)
end

local function purgeCustomLeaderboards()
	local playerGui = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
	if not playerGui then return end
	local commonLeaderboardNames = {"leaderboard", "playerlist", "tabmenu", "scoreboard"}
	for _, ui in ipairs(playerGui:GetChildren()) do
		local lowerName = string.lower(ui.Name)
		for _, targetName in ipairs(commonLeaderboardNames) do
			if string.find(lowerName, targetName) then
				ui:Destroy()
				break
			end
		end
	end
end

local playerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
playerGui.ChildAdded:Connect(function()
	if not leaderboardVisible then purgeCustomLeaderboards() end
end)

local function clearWorkbenchHighlights()
	for _, desc in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if desc:IsA("Highlight") and desc.Name == WORKBENCH_HL_NAME then
			desc:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

local function applyWorkbenchHighlight(obj)
	if not workbenchEspEnabled then return end
	if obj.Name == "Workbench" and not obj:FindFirstChild(WORKBENCH_HL_NAME) then
		local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
		hl.Name = WORKBENCH_HL_NAME
		hl.Adornee = obj
		hl.FillColor = WORKBENCH_COLOR
		hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		hl.FillTransparency = 0.4
		hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
		hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
		hl.Parent = obj
	end
end

local function refreshWorkbenchESP()
	clearWorkbenchHighlights()
	if not workbenchEspEnabled then return end
	for _, desc in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		applyWorkbenchHighlight(desc)
	end
end

Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(desc)
	if desc.Name == "Workbench" then
		task.wait(0.1)
		applyWorkbenchHighlight(desc)
	end
end)

        local percent = math.clamp(mouseX / sliderWidth, 0, 1)
        
        local speed = math.floor(16 + percent * (300 - 16))
        setSpeed(speed)
    end
end)
